card.name: Space before a number in doses and tables
card.fires_on: The space just before a digit, such as after Day, Table, or gel, or a zero inside a number, in dosing text and tables. It is strongest where a numeral comes next.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space after a label word like Day or Table, right before a numeral.

modes.label: Zero inside numbers
modes.description: A zero digit in the middle of a numeric table or a large figure.
